name: Barmah Park Vineyard
signature: A Moorooduc cellar door with guided tastings at the bar and a restaurant on the same site.
editorNote: Barmah Park’s cellar door lists tastings from 11am to 5pm, Wednesday to Sunday. The team says tastings usually take 15–30 minutes, depending on the option. If you’ve booked lunch at the restaurant, allow 30 minutes beforehand and check the current tasting options with the cellar door.
whyWeGo: Taste first, then stay for lunch without another drive.
ifOnlyOneThing: Allow 30 minutes for a tasting before your lunch booking.

heroImage.alt: Bunches of white wine grapes hanging on the vine among broad green leaves.
heroImage.depicts: bunches of white wine grapes on the vine

piLine: Fit a tasting in before lunch; allow half an hour.
